facts.fact: The FY2025/26 estimates allocate BWP 594,362,280 in recurrent funding to the Department of Shared Digital Services of the Ministry of Communications and Innovation; recurrent estimates were not revised in the year.
facts.system: Department of Shared Digital Services recurrent estimate, FY2025/26

note: No prior-year figure for the department in this document, so no rose or fell fact; the ministry's 68 percent recurrent execution is ministry-wide, not the department's.
